'''Revwien coleslaw''' was served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> At the diner, the dish was offered as a lunch side, where it could be purchased for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|coleslaw]] shared its name with the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwiens]],<ref name="Dex's" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Revyia]].<ref name="gg12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have a fondness for abandoned concepts, hence the inclusion of the donut droid as well as references to Revwiens, Adarians, apple slugs and even Kenner's Mongo Beefhead Tribesman.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Revwien coleslaw was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex's" /> Walker mentioned Revwiens in the article due to a fondness for abandoned concepts;<ref name="Blog" /> the Revwiens were intended to appear in<ref name="Revwien">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but the complexity of their costume forced the idea to be scrapped.<ref name="Revwien" />
